need_statement: Maintain sufficient cooling capacity for critical IT load throughout required operating periods
rationale: Cooling is mission enabling for continuous IT operation

need_statement: Maintain visibility of cooling redundancy and thermal margin before conditions threaten IT operations
rationale: Operators need time to respond before service impact

need_statement: Detect degradation early and restore failed cooling assets within defined maintainability limits
rationale: Reduce corrective exposure and degraded redundancy time

need_statement: Provide reliable operational data for performance degradation and energy analysis
Demonstrate measurable lifecycle operating value from the selected modernization
rationale: Investment must have a transparent benefit case

need_statement: Avoid cooling-related conditions that materially affect contracted IT services
Maintain appropriate separation and least-privilege access across control supervisory and analytics functions
rationale: Modernization must not introduce unacceptable OT cyber exposure
